use.flag: Make the tray icon toggle the main window on click (show when hidden, hide when visible) — mirrors the Viber tray-toggle patch. NOTE: on this app (Electron 17 + libappindicator over the MATE SNI tray) the left click does NOT reach the app at all (the SNI item lacks the "Activate" method), so on Linux the right-click tray menu (Show/Hide/Quit) is the working interaction; the toggle handlers apply on platforms where click events are delivered.
